title: From idea to
description: A clear process without unnecessary words — from first contact to going live. You always know what's happening.

steps.title: Getting acquainted
steps.description: You write to me — tell me about your business, goals and wishes. Together we develop a clear vision for your website.

steps.title: Briefing & structure
steps.description: I define UX, page structure and technical requirements. The logic is established before the first design.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: I create a design in your aesthetic. Every screen is thoughtful, aligned and ready for development.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: Clean and fast execution. Responsive design, SEO, optimisation and integrations are included as standard.

steps.title: Launch & support
steps.description: I test, publish and show you how everything works. I remain reachable even after launch.
